title: Amazonian tribesmen identify a grey as Makunwabu

tellings.quote: They found an alien gray and they showed this alien gray and the Amazonian tribe and went that's Makunwabu.

plain: When people showed an image of a "grey", the small grey-skinned alien with large dark eyes that many abduction accounts describe, to a tribe in the Amazon, the tribesmen recognised it and said "that's Makunwabu," a name of their own. Jay Anderson tells Michels this second-hand and does not say who showed the image. The point is that a people far from modern UFO lore seemed to already know the being.
